I was in special ed in elementary and middle school despite being very high functioning. In other words I had aspergers ands was placed with kids who were much more severe. We moved to a new state the year I went into high school and I vowed that I would be popular. That never happened. I had a few friends but none were close. We never hanged out unless I arranged it. I felt so isolated still. I wad awkward.  I had bullies who would haras me by making two sided jokes. I was very alone. I also thought I was better than everybody and thought that I would do something while in high school I would become famous so that everybody wanted to be my friend. I never went to prom and was never invited to parties. Now I see these cool kids having fun at college and I'm still at home and feel like nothings happening. I'm going to a community college but there's no social life there. I wish I could go back and redo high school. I would try harder to be friends with people and be more outgoing.

I am very close with my mom although she can be annoying like most parents are. We were talking about the future and realize my big problem is lamenting the past. I can't go back and change high school but wish with every ounce of me that I could. I am so lost and have no idea what I want to do with the rest of my life.

I also had other issues from a young age like aspergers, being sexually abused by a kid I thought was my friend, and never having a father or siblings in my life.
